review.title: The Coffee Khamrah
review.text: Khamrah with coffee added. Cinnamon, ginger and praline up top, then vanilla, tonka and a roasted coffee note. Fragrantica voters give it 4.32 out of 5 across 17,000+ votes, and the vast majority say winter. At about $32 it's an easy cold-weather buy, as long as you like sweet.

review.title: The Dark Horse
review.text: Lavender, nutmeg and sage open it, then cedar, maple and cocoa-style notes. It's more aromatic and less sugary than most Lattafa picks. Rated 4.28 out of 5 on Fragrantica with 1,700+ votes, and most say winter or spring. Around $42.

review.title: The Layton Lane
